items.name: PropagationResult
items.summary: This object encapsulates all possible constraint propagation results.

items.name: propagate_arithmetic
items.summary: This function refines intervals `left_child` and `right_child` by applying constraint propagation through `parent` via operation. The main idea is that we can shrink ranges of variables x and y using parent interval p.

items.name: propagate_comparison

items.name: ExprIntervalGraph
items.summary: This object implements a directed acyclic expression graph (DAEG) that is used to compute ranges for expressions through interval arithmetic.

methods.name: assign_intervals
methods.summary: This function assigns given ranges to expressions in the DAEG. The argument `assignments` associates indices of sought expressions with their corresponding new ranges.

methods.name: evaluate_bounds
methods.summary: Computes bounds for an expression using interval arithmetic via a bottom-up traversal.

methods.name: gather_node_indices
methods.signature: fn gather_node_indices(&mut self, exprs: &[Arc<dyn PhysicalExpr>]) -> Vec<(Arc<dyn PhysicalExpr>, usize)>
methods.summary: This function associates stable node indices with [`PhysicalExpr`]s so that we can match `Arc<dyn PhysicalExpr>` and NodeIndex objects during membership tests.

methods.name: get_interval
methods.summary: Returns the interval associated with the node at the given `index`.

methods.name: try_new
methods.signature: fn try_new(expr: Arc<dyn PhysicalExpr>, schema: &Schema) -> Result<Self>

methods.name: update_intervals
methods.summary: This function fetches ranges of expressions from the DAEG. The argument `assignments` associates indices of sought expressions with their ranges, which this function modifies to reflect the intervals in the DAEG.

methods.name: update_ranges
methods.signature: fn update_ranges(&mut self, leaf_bounds: &mut [(usize, Interval)], given_range: Interval) -> Result<PropagationResult>
methods.summary: Updates intervals for all expressions in the DAEG by successive bottom-up and top-down traversals.

items.name: ExprIntervalGraphNode
items.summary: This is a node in the DAEG; it encapsulates a reference to the actual [`PhysicalExpr`] as well as an interval containing expression bounds.

methods.name: interval
methods.summary: Get the interval object representing the range of the expression.

methods.name: make_node
methods.summary: This function creates a DAEG node from DataFusion's [`ExprTreeNode`] object. Literals are created with definite, singleton intervals while any other expression starts with an indefinite interval (`[-∞, ∞]`).

methods.name: new_unbounded
methods.signature: fn new_unbounded(expr: Arc<dyn PhysicalExpr>, dt: &DataType) -> Result<Self>
methods.summary: Constructs a new DAEG node with an `[-∞, ∞]` range.

methods.name: new_with_interval
methods.signature: fn new_with_interval(expr: Arc<dyn PhysicalExpr>, interval: Interval) -> Self
methods.summary: Constructs a new DAEG node with the given range.
